title: 합석
scene: 헌팅포차(처음 보는 사람끼리 합석하는 술집). 옆 테이블 하늘과 친구 해솔. A 의 친구가 「가 봐!」 하고 등을 민다
goal: Asking a nearby table to join you, Korean pub style

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Excuse me… can we join your table?

turns.speaker: C
turns.en: Your friend just went to the bathroom, though?

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Oh… then right now it’s just one.

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Haha, you came over alone to ask us to join?

turns.speaker: A
turns.ko: 친구가 가라고 해서요. 근데 걔가 도망갔어요.
turns.rd: chinguga garago haeseoyo. geunde gyaega domanggasseoyo.
turns.en: My friend told me to go. But he ran away.

turns.speaker: C
turns.en: Right. He’s over there paying the bill.
turns.note: Kick: the friend is literally leaving

turns.speaker: A
turns.ko: …아 몰라. 그냥 저 혼자 껴도 돼요?
turns.rd: …a molla. geunyang jeo honja kkyeodo dwaeyo?
turns.en: …Ugh, whatever. Can I just squeeze in alone?
turns.note: 껴도 돼요? = can I squeeze in / join?

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Your courage is cute, so I’ll let it slide. Sit.
turns.note: 봐 준다 = I'll let you off

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Really? Then I’ll buy the snacks.
turns.note: 안주 = food you eat with drinks

turns.speaker: B
turns.ko: 좋아. 대신 친구 다시 오면 쫓아내.
turns.rd: joa. daesin chingu dasi omyeon jjochanae.
turns.en: Deal. But if your friend comes back, kick him out.
